The second step is sulfonylation of that aniline with 4‑fluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride to afford the target molecule. Template IDs 1258606 and 746148 were taken from the template catalog and correspond to the respective transformations. All leaf compounds (aryl bromide, Boc‑piperazine, and 4‑fluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride) are standard commercial reagents, keeping the total cost well below the $9999 limit.</thought>
